public_rationale: Under the contextual reading of partial but unreliable generalization, the claim is supported. GSM-Plus finds successful handling of some variations alongside substantial failures on others across many models and prompting methods. Earlier planning research demonstrates meaningful successes, so the evidence supports a reliability limitation rather than a blanket claim that models cannot reason, plan, or generalize.
limitations: The outcome depends on interpreting 'not enough' through the surrounding discussion of reliability.
The evidence does not establish an AGI threshold or a permanent limitation.
One benchmark family cannot characterize all current AI models and uses.

from_speaker: current models aren’t literally look up tables

our_interpretation: The surrounding sentences connect 'not enough' to reliable reasoning and planning beyond familiar training examples.
I therefore read this as some successful transfer to new examples alongside substantial failures under modest task changes, rather than a claim of no generalization.
I do not impose an unstated AGI benchmark or require perfect performance.

For current models, I use the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, January through March 2024. Model evaluations have no uniform reporting cycle, so this is an explicit recency convention.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations of current models show successful transfer on some new task variants but substantial, systematic failures on other meaningful reasoning or planning variants.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations show reliable transfer across unfamiliar reasoning and planning variants, undermining the claimed insufficiency.

evidence.explanation: The study evaluates 25 LLMs and four prompting techniques. It reports resilience to some numerical and wording changes alongside substantial failures under other mathematical perturbations, supporting the contextual claim of partial but unreliable generalization.

GPT-4 generated planning programs that generalized to other tasks with automated debugging support. This challenges any blanket dismissal of planning generalization, but predates the target quarter and does not establish broad reliability.
